style: Modern pixel art with soft lighting (Style D): a small dark-purple cave bat with pink glowing eyes, a clean dark outline, chunky readable pixels, gentle highlights and shading. Match the character, colours and proportions of the reference image exactly. Side view, the creature facing right. Draw only the creature: no ground, no thread, no rope, no shadow, no effects.
